description: Use when an agent has an origin ASN and must decide who is behind a network and whether it is still live: the RDAP registry record (holder, status, allocation dates, abuse contact), the AS name, country and RIR, and the prefixes it announces right now, split IPv4 and IPv6 with a sample.
